authentication_type.description: Default authentication. Possible values: 0 - (default) Internal; 1 - LDAP.

http_auth_enabled.description: Enable HTTP authentication. Possible values: 0 - (default) Disable; 1 - Enable.

http_login_form.description: Default login form. Possible values: 0 - (default) Zabbix login form; 1 - HTTP login form.

http_case_sensitive.description: HTTP case-sensitive login. Possible values: 0 - Off; 1 - (default) On.

ldap_configured.description: Enable LDAP authentication. Possible values: 0 - Disable; 1 - (default) Enable.

ldap_case_sensitive.description: LDAP case-sensitive login. Possible values: 0 - Off; 1 - (default) On.

saml_auth_enabled.description: Enable SAML authentication. Possible values: 0 - (default) Disable; 1 - Enable.

saml_sign_messages.description: SAML sign messages. Possible values: 0 - (default) Do not sign messages; 1 - Sign messages.

saml_sign_assertions.description: SAML sign assertions. Possible values: 0 - (default) Do not sign assertions; 1 - Sign assertions.

saml_sign_authn_requests.description: SAML sign AuthN requests. Possible values: 0 - (default) Do not sign AuthN requests; 1 - Sign AuthN requests.

saml_sign_logout_requests.description: SAML sign logout requests. Possible values: 0 - (default) Do not sign logout requests; 1 - Sign logout requests.

saml_sign_logout_responses.description: SAML sign logout responses. Possible values: 0 - (default) Do not sign logout responses; 1 - Sign logout responses.

saml_encrypt_nameid.description: SAML encrypt name ID. Possible values: 0 - (default) Do not encrypt name ID; 1 - Encrypt name ID.

saml_encrypt_assertions.description: SAML encrypt assertions. Possible values: 0 - (default) Do not encrypt assertions; 1 - Encrypt assertions.

saml_case_sensitive.description: SAML case-sensitive login. Possible values: 0 - Off; 1 - (default) On.

passwd_min_length.description: Password minimal length requirement. Possible range of values: 1-70. Default: 8.

passwd_check_rules.description: Password checking rules. Possible bitmap values are: 0 - Check password length; 1 - Check if password uses uppercase and lowercase Latin letters; 2 - Check if password uses digits; 4 - Check if password uses special characters; 8 - (default) Check if password is not in the list of commonly used passwords and does not contain derivations of word "Zabbix" or user's name, last name, or username. This is a bitmask field; any sum of possible bitmap values is acceptable (for example, 15 for checking all rules).
